name: Medicine shortages
value: US 225 active shortages; chemo drugs short
summary: US counts 225 active drug shortages with chemotherapy shortages rising; no widespread rationing reported
state: ASHP counted 225 active US drug shortages in the third quarter, with chemotherapy shortages rising after flooding at a Pfizer plant in India that may disrupt supply into 2028; cytarabine and irinotecan injections were added to its list on 7 and 12 Oct (Becker's Hospital Review, 26 Oct). Searches on 28 Nov found no widespread rationing or cancelled treatment across major health systems, so Watch holds.
for_you: Cancer patients on affected chemotherapy drugs are most exposed to delays or changed regimens. Hospitals and pharmacists manage substitutions; the NHS and FDA list current shortages.
rubric_hit: Watch held: essential chemotherapy drugs in shortage (225 active US shortages, ASHP Q3); no widespread rationing

sources.title: Becker's Hospital Review — The 2026 chemo shortage: a timeline

why: Shipping disruption, factory failures and export curbs can leave essential medicines short, as with US IV fluids after Hurricane Helene in 2024.
drivers: Manufacturing concentrated in India and China, shipping, raw materials, demand spikes, regulation.

rubric.alert: Shortages forcing widespread rationing or cancelled treatment across major health systems.
rubric.watch: A shortage of an essential medicine or supply across several countries, or a UK Serious Shortage Protocol for a widely used medicine.
rubric.normal: No widespread shortages of essential medicines in major health systems.
